title: Kimchi Pancakes Kimchijeon

description: Kimchi Pancakes, known as Kimchijeon, are beloved savory Korean appetizers featuring fermented kimchi mixed into a crispy, flavorful batter. These pan-fried delights offer a perfect balance of spicy, tangy, and umami notes, making them an irresistible snack or side dish. Enjoy the delightful crunch on the outside and the tender, savory interior that defines this classic Korean comfort food.

ingredients.item: Dipping Sauce: gochugaru Korean chili flakes

instructions.title: Prepare Kimchi and Vegetables
instructions.text: Finely chop the aged kimchi into small pieces and gently squeeze out any excessive liquid. Reserve the kimchi juice. Chop the green onions into 1-inch lengths and thinly slice the optional onion. Set aside.

instructions.title: Whisk the Batter
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, cold water, reserved kimchi juice, egg, sugar, and salt. Whisk until just combined and a smooth batter forms. Be careful not to overmix, as this can make the pancakes tough. A few small lumps are acceptable.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: Add the chopped kimchi, green onions, and sliced onion if using, to the prepared batter. Gently fold all the ingredients together until they are evenly distributed throughout the batter. The mixture should be thick enough to hold its shape but still pourable.

instructions.title: Heat the Pan
instructions.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet or cast-iron pan over medium-high heat. Add 1-2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, ensuring the entire surface of the pan is coated. The oil should be shimmering hot before adding the batter to ensure a crispy pancake.

instructions.title: Fry the Pancakes
instructions.text: Pour about 1/4 to 1/3 cup of the kimchi pancake batter into the hot pan, spreading it thinly with the back of a spoon to form a round pancake. Do not overcrowd the pan; cook 1-2 pancakes at a time. Fry for 3-5 minutes per side, until golden brown and crispy.

instructions.title: Continue Frying and Crisping
instructions.text: Once the edges look set and the bottom is golden brown, carefully flip the pancake. Press down lightly with a spatula to ensure even cooking and crispiness. Continue to cook for another 3-5 minutes until the second side is also golden brown and the pancake is cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter, adding more oil as needed, until all pancakes are cooked to a crispy perfection.

instructions.title: Prepare Dipping Sauce and Serve
instructions.text: While the pancakes are cooking, prepare the dipping sauce by combining soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and toasted sesame seeds in a small bowl. Add gochugaru if desired. Serve the hot, crispy Kimchi Pancakes immediately with the dipping sauce on the side. They are best enjoyed fresh.

tips: Use well-fermented, sour kimchi for the best authentic flavor. The more aged the kimchi, the deeper the taste it imparts to the pancakes.
For extra crispiness, consider adding a tablespoon of rice flour or cornstarch to your batter along with the all-purpose flour.
Serve Kimchi Pancakes immediately after frying to enjoy their optimal crispy texture. Leftovers can be reheated in a dry pan over medium heat for a few minutes per side to regain some crispness.
